recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white portrait of a long-haired male figure in a dark jacket, positioned in an urban alleyway. The lighting is dramatic, casting deep shadows and highlighting facial features and brick textures. A metallic railing cuts across the foreground, creating depth, while bold, stylized typography is anchored in the upper right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal foreground railing leads the eye toward the subject's face.
The subject's gaze is directed away from the camera, creating a sense of introspection.
The rough texture of the brick wall contrasts with the smooth, high-key lighting on the subject's skin.
The typography is layered over the background, separate from the subject's silhouette.
coreInvariants: Monochrome color palette for the image area.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is positioned on the left third of the frame, medium-close-up scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's brightly lit face serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye moves from the bright face, down the diagonal railing, then up to the text in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black shadows in the lower half and left side provide a dense, moody negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and charcoal tones provide the foundation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-key white highlights on the face and brick edges.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale blue and yellow are used exclusively for the primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero saturation in the image; low-saturation pastels in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold sans-serif for the primary line; wide-tracked serif for the secondary line.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses heavy, blocky glyphs with minimal spacing.
Secondary text uses thin, elegant strokes with extreme letter-spacing (tracking).
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard font geometry is maintained.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy condensed sans-serif paired with light, widely-spaced serif for a classic 80s editorial look.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows on primary text to separate it from the textured background.

preserve: Extreme tracking on the second line

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed weight of the primary display text.
Provides the sharp, high-contrast serif look for the secondary line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a black and white photograph of a man with long feathered hair wearing a dark leather jacket in a brick alleyway at night. Use harsh side-lighting. Include a dark metal pipe or railing in the foreground at a 45-degree angle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top right corner. Line 1: Extra-bold condensed sans-serif in light blue with a black drop shadow. Line 2: Light serif in pale yellow with extreme letter spacing, aligned to the width of Line 1.

verificationChecks: Is the foreground railing present and diagonal?
Does the secondary text have wide tracking?

adjustableVariables: Specific pastel hues of the typography
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the subject's face is the brightest point.
Verify the text does not obscure the subject's face.
Check that the brick wall has visible depth and shadow.
Confirm the typography uses the specified color contrast against the dark background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Noir Portrait = (High-Contrast B&W Photo + Industrial Setting + Diagonal Foreground Element) + (Top-Right Aligned Dual-Weight Typography)
